# Saudex Global

> Saudex Global is a Singapore-registered logistics, import/export and freight forwarding company serving businesses across Asia and the Middle East, with a focus on the Singapore-GCC-APAC trade corridor.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://saudexglobal.com/services/): Logistics services overview
- [Import & Export](https://saudexglobal.com/services/impo-expo/): Import/export support and supplier coordination
- [Freight Forwarding](https://saudexglobal.com/services/freight/): Sea, air and land freight
- [FMCG Distribution](https://saudexglobal.com/services/fmcg/): FMCG distribution services
- [Customs Clearance](https://saudexglobal.com/services/customs/): Customs documentation and compliance
- [Distribution](https://saudexglobal.com/services/distribution/): Regional distribution and delivery
- [Supply Chain](https://saudexglobal.com/services/Supply_chain/): Supply chain consulting and logistics
- [Warehousing](https://saudexglobal.com/services/warehousing/): Storage and inventory management

## Industries

- [Food & Beverage](https://saudexglobal.com/industries/food_beverages/): Food and beverage logistics
- [HoReCa](https://saudexglobal.com/industries/horeca/): Hospitality supply and logistics
- [Agriculture](https://saudexglobal.com/industries/agriculture/): Agricultural commodities and palm oil
- [FMCG](https://saudexglobal.com/industries/fmcg_industry/): Consumer goods logistics
- [Retail](https://saudexglobal.com/industries/retail/): Retail and wholesale support
- [E-Commerce](https://saudexglobal.com/industries/e_commerce/): E-commerce fulfilment and shipping
